svg.text: Storyboard v2 · IAT 806 final project. How a visitor moves through the instrument and what the system does at each step.
Cards are states (the sketch is what the screen shows). Arrows are the trigger that moves to the next state. Diamonds are decisions. Numbers match the pseudocode.
takes effect on the next downbeat
cyan = what you put in · magenta = what the model writes · amber = playhead / pending

p5.js: radial sequencer, particles, all controls. One
MIDI-GPT HTTP server: track generation and bar infilling
audio track → FX → mix; MIDI → synth → FX → mix.
Pseudocode — the same flow as the diagram
on mic > -30 dB or tap(LOOP | ONE_SHOT | STREAM) or dropFile:
req = { audio: features(audio), midi: midiTracks, bars: 4, temp, density }
if queued: pending = post('/generate', queued); queued = {}
if arcSelected: pending = post('/infill', track, barsIn(arc), pinned)
gestures, sensors, OCR -> same calls as the controls
on touch: state = PLAYING; if emptyFor(5 min): reset(); state = IDLE
Sketches drawn with AI assistance (Claude); ideas and direction are mine.
